All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
App
Main application class for the Space Gravity Simulator.
Body
Represents a physical body in the simulation, characterized by its mass, position, velocity, acceleration, and radius.
Camera
Represents the simulation camera, which manages the visible portion of the world and provides transformations between world and screen coordinates.
FollowPrompt
A dialog prompt that allows the user to select a celestial body to follow in the simulation.
FollowPrompt.FollowResult
Represents the result of the follow prompt, containing the selected body and zoom preference.
GridHandler
Handles rendering of the background grid for the simulation.
HUDHandler
Responsible for rendering the Heads-Up Display (HUD) overlay in the simulation.
InputHandler
Handles all user input for the simulation, including mouse and keyboard events.
InputHandler.AimingData
Represents data related to aiming, such as the starting point, the corresponding screen coordinates, and the current aim position.
MassPrompt
A dialog prompt for setting the properties of a new celestial body.
MassPrompt.BodyProperties
Represents the properties of a celestial body.
ModifyBodyPrompt
A dialog prompt for modifying the properties of an existing celestial body.
ModifyBodyPrompt.BodyProperties
Represents the modified properties of a celestial body.
RenderManager
Manages the rendering of the simulation, including the main game loop, body rendering, and camera updates.
Simulation
Represents the physics simulation of bodies under gravity.
TimeTravelManager
Manages time-travel functionality, allowing the simulation to save and restore states.
UIManager
Manages the UI components, including buttons, toolbars, and transitions.
Vector2D
Represents a 2D vector with common vector operations such as addition, subtraction, scaling, and magnitude.
